items.headline: 'Angry' Rhule fires OC Holgorsen amid Nebraska's 4-game skid
items.description: Nebraska's Matt Rhule has fired offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen after the Huskers have averaged just 13.5 points during a four-game Big Ten losing streak.

items.headline: Collin Dixon's 2 TD catches help Illinois become bowl eligible with 24-13 victory over Nebraska
items.description: — Collin Dixon caught two touchdown passes including a record-breaker and Illinois used a trick play to set up its go-ahead TD as the Illini defeated Nebraska 24-13 on Friday night to become bowl eligible with their fourth straight victory.
